# nexus completion get

Print the shell completion script

Print the completion script for a shell to stdout.

bash (needs the bash-completion package):
  nexus completion get --shell bash > ~/.nexus.bash && echo '. ~/.nexus.bash' >> ~/.bashrc
zsh (needs compinit):
  nexus completion get --shell zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_nexus"
fish:
  nexus completion get --shell fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/nexus.fish

## Usage

```
nexus completion get --shell bash|zsh|fish [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  nexus completion get --shell bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/nexus
  nexus completion get --shell fish | source
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help           help for get
      --shell string   bash, zsh or fish
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
